{"reason": "Both example stockouts (195000 each) are medium-risk rows with inventory-days 5.3 and 2.8 falling to suggest-alternative-supplier. Widening the alert-planner branch from high/<5 to medium+/<7 gives premium freight (35000, always on time) there, cutting stockouts and cost; high rows under 7 also drop 45000→35000. Medium/high rows ≥7 keep the supplier branch; low stays monitor.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 7))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'suggest-alternative-supplier))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
